description: Defines both the durability threshold, and the effects emitted when that threshold is met.

durability.description: The effects are emitted when the item durability value is less than or equal to this value.

particle_type.description: Particle effect to emit when the threshold is met.

sound_event.description: Sound effect to emit when the threshold is met. Accepts the name of any sound event defined in `sound_definitions.json`, including the built-in vanilla sound events.

title: minecraft:durability_sensor durability_threshold
